about: Editing keys in Bloom fields (sample/EditingProbe.tsx), each step checking where the text and selection end up as the application receives them, and exactly which events it received: by word with Alt, a Mac's ⌥ (ICU's word boundaries, as Android; ADR 0037), deletion by word, undo and redo (one step for continued typing), and in a multiline field Up and Down keeping their column, Home and End at the line's edges, Ctrl+Home and Ctrl+End at the text's, a selection across lines, a wrapped line's edges as drawn, and a press on the line it wraps onto; and text taller or wider than its field scrolled to keep the caret in view (Page Up and Page Down by what the field shows), presses landing where the scrolled text is drawn; the wheel scrolls a field's text, focused or not, before the scroll views around it; and every scroll of a field's text is an onScroll event, as Android's; and copy, cut and paste through the compositor's clipboard (ADR 0007), a paste being an edit of its own; undo after a cut, a new edit leaving nothing to redo, typing and Backspace undone as one typing as a Mac's Undo Typing, and a move (even back to the same place) or a paste ending it; Ctrl+Delete to the line's end and, at it, joining the next line (a Mac's ⌘⌦). Every step also checks the field the compositor holds, the state an input method reads: its text, selection and caret rectangle. Through the virtual devices (`--uinput`) each character is typed as a key: React then receives a key press, a change and a selection change for each, as from Android's keyboard.

type three words

again, to the start of the word before
Alt+Right goes to the end of the word
Alt+Shift+Right selects to the end of the next word
Right collapses the selection to its end
Alt+Backspace deletes the word before the caret
Alt+Left, to the start of the second word
Alt+Delete deletes the word after the caret

and again, the typing
with nothing left to undo, Ctrl+Z does nothing
Ctrl+Shift+Z redoes the typing

Ctrl+Home to its start

Shift+Down selects across two lines
Ctrl+End collapses the selection at the end
